query: Advertise the VLAN 100 subnet (10.100.1.0/24) from L1.
reference_playbook:
---
- name: Agentic-SONiC bench_net dataset item - BGP-E-03
  hosts: sonic_switches
  gather_facts: false
  become: true
  become_method: sudo
  tasks:

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # Safety pre-checks: verify each router runs the expected AS
    # L1 (SONiC-VS-1) = 65001, S1 (SONiC-VS-5) = 65100, S2 (SONiC-VS-6) = 65100
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    - name: Verify SONiC-VS-1 (L1) is running AS 65001 before making any change
      raw: sudo vtysh -c "show ip bgp summary"
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-1"
      register: l1_bgp_precheck
      failed_when: >-
        l1_bgp_precheck.rc != 0
        or 'local AS number 65001' not in l1_bgp_precheck.stdout
      changed_when: false

    - name: Verify SONiC-VS-5 (S1) is running AS 65100 before making any change
      raw: sudo vtysh -c "show ip bgp summary"
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-5"
      register: s1_bgp_precheck
      failed_when: >-
        s1_bgp_precheck.rc != 0
        or 'local AS number 65100' not in s1_bgp_precheck.stdout
      changed_when: false

    - name: Verify SONiC-VS-6 (S2) is running AS 65100 before making any change
      raw: sudo vtysh -c "show ip bgp summary"
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-6"
      register: s2_bgp_precheck
      failed_when: >-
        s2_bgp_precheck.rc != 0
        or 'local AS number 65100' not in s2_bgp_precheck.stdout
      changed_when: false

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # L1 (SONiC-VS-1): route-map + network 10.100.1.0/24
    # (Vlan100 / 10.100.1.1/24 already exists, so it is not touched)
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    - name: Configure route-map and advertise 10.100.1.0/24 on L1 (SONiC-VS-1)
      raw: >-
        sudo vtysh -c "configure terminal"
        -c "route-map PERMIT-ALL permit 10"
        -c "exit"
        -c "router bgp 65001"
        -c "address-family ipv4 unicast"
        -c "neighbor 10.1.1.1 route-map PERMIT-ALL in"
        -c "neighbor 10.1.1.1 route-map PERMIT-ALL out"
        -c "neighbor 10.1.2.1 route-map PERMIT-ALL in"
        -c "neighbor 10.1.2.1 route-map PERMIT-ALL out"
        -c "network 10.100.1.0/24"
        -c "exit-address-family"
        -c "exit"
        -c "exit"
        -c "write memory"
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-1"
      ignore_errors: true

    - name: Verify L1 (SONiC-VS-1) running-config contains the network statement and route-maps
      raw: sudo vtysh -c "show running-config"
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-1"
      register: l1_runcfg_output
      failed_when: >-
        l1_runcfg_output.rc != 0
        or 'network 10.100.1.0/24' not in l1_runcfg_output.stdout
        or 'route-map PERMIT-ALL permit 10' not in l1_runcfg_output.stdout
      changed_when: false

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # S1 (SONiC-VS-5): route-map + accept eBGP routes without policy
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    - name: Configure route-map and eBGP acceptance on S1 (SONiC-VS-5)
      raw: >-
        sudo vtysh -c "configure terminal"
        -c "route-map PERMIT-ALL permit 10"
        -c "exit"
        -c "router bgp 65100"
        -c "no bgp ebgp-requires-policy"
        -c "address-family ipv4 unicast"
        -c "neighbor 10.1.1.0 route-map PERMIT-ALL in"
        -c "neighbor 10.1.1.0 route-map PERMIT-ALL out"
        -c "exit-address-family"
        -c "exit"
        -c "exit"
        -c "write memory"
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-5"
      ignore_errors: true

    - name: Verify S1 (SONiC-VS-5) running-config has route-map and ebgp-requires-policy disabled
      raw: sudo vtysh -c "show running-config"
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-5"
      register: s1_runcfg_output
      failed_when: >-
        s1_runcfg_output.rc != 0
        or 'no bgp ebgp-requires-policy' not in s1_runcfg_output.stdout
        or 'route-map PERMIT-ALL permit 10' not in s1_runcfg_output.stdout
      changed_when: false

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # S2 (SONiC-VS-6): route-map + accept eBGP routes without policy
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    - name: Configure route-map and eBGP acceptance on S2 (SONiC-VS-6)
      raw: >-
        sudo vtysh -c "configure terminal"
        -c "route-map PERMIT-ALL permit 10"
        -c "exit"
        -c "router bgp 65100"
        -c "no bgp ebgp-requires-policy"
        -c "address-family ipv4 unicast"
        -c "neighbor 10.1.2.0 route-map PERMIT-ALL in"
        -c "neighbor 10.1.2.0 route-map PERMIT-ALL out"
        -c "exit-address-family"
        -c "exit"
        -c "exit"
        -c "write memory"
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-6"
      ignore_errors: true

    - name: Verify S2 (SONiC-VS-6) running-config has route-map and ebgp-requires-policy disabled
      raw: sudo vtysh -c "show running-config"
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-6"
      register: s2_runcfg_output
      failed_when: >-
        s2_runcfg_output.rc != 0
        or 'no bgp ebgp-requires-policy' not in s2_runcfg_output.stdout
        or 'route-map PERMIT-ALL permit 10' not in s2_runcfg_output.stdout
      changed_when: false

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # Verify outbound advertisements from L1 to S1 and S2
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    - name: Verify 10.100.1.0/24 is advertised to S1 (10.1.1.1) from SONiC-VS-1
      raw: sudo vtysh -c "show ip bgp neighbors 10.1.1.1 advertised-routes"
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-1"
      register: l1_adv_to_s1_output
      until: l1_adv_to_s1_output.rc == 0 and '10.100.1.0/24' in l1_adv_to_s1_output.stdout
      retries: 6
      delay: 5
      changed_when: false

    - name: Verify 10.100.1.0/24 is advertised to S2 (10.1.2.1) from SONiC-VS-1
      raw: sudo vtysh -c "show ip bgp neighbors 10.1.2.1 advertised-routes"
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-1"
      register: l1_adv_to_s2_output
      until: l1_adv_to_s2_output.rc == 0 and '10.100.1.0/24' in l1_adv_to_s2_output.stdout
      retries: 6
      delay: 5
      changed_when: false

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # Verify S1 and S2 both received 10.100.1.0/24 (BGP table + kernel)
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    - name: Verify S1 (SONiC-VS-5) BGP table has 10.100.1.0/24
      raw: sudo vtysh -c "show ip bgp 10.100.1.0/24"
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-5"
      register: s1_bgp_route_output
      until: s1_bgp_route_output.rc == 0 and '10.100.1.0/24' in s1_bgp_route_output.stdout
      retries: 6
      delay: 5
      changed_when: false

    - name: Verify S2 (SONiC-VS-6) BGP table has 10.100.1.0/24
      raw: sudo vtysh -c "show ip bgp 10.100.1.0/24"
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-6"
      register: s2_bgp_route_output
      until: s2_bgp_route_output.rc == 0 and '10.100.1.0/24' in s2_bgp_route_output.stdout
      retries: 6
      delay: 5
      changed_when: false

    - name: Verify S1 (SONiC-VS-5) installed kernel route to 10.100.1.0/24
      raw: ip route show 10.100.1.0/24
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-5"
      register: s1_ip_route_output
      until: s1_ip_route_output.rc == 0 and '10.100.1.0/24' in s1_ip_route_output.stdout
      retries: 6
      delay: 5
      changed_when: false

    - name: Verify S2 (SONiC-VS-6) installed kernel route to 10.100.1.0/24
      raw: ip route show 10.100.1.0/24
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-6"
      register: s2_ip_route_output
      until: s2_ip_route_output.rc == 0 and '10.100.1.0/24' in s2_ip_route_output.stdout
      retries: 6
      delay: 5
      changed_when: false

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # Verify sessions remain Established
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    - name: Verify session L1-S1 (10.1.1.1) is Established on SONiC-VS-1
      raw: sudo vtysh -c "show ip bgp neighbors 10.1.1.1" | grep -i "BGP state"
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-1"
      register: l1_s1_state_output
      failed_when: l1_s1_state_output.rc != 0 or 'established' not in l1_s1_state_output.stdout | lower
      changed_when: false

    - name: Verify session L1-S2 (10.1.2.1) is Established on SONiC-VS-1
      raw: sudo vtysh -c "show ip bgp neighbors 10.1.2.1" | grep -i "BGP state"
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-1"
      register: l1_s2_state_output
      failed_when: l1_s2_state_output.rc != 0 or 'established' not in l1_s2_state_output.stdout | lower
      changed_when: false

    - name: Verify session S2-L2 (10.2.2.0) is Established on SONiC-VS-6
      raw: sudo vtysh -c "show ip bgp neighbors 10.2.2.0" | grep -i "BGP state"
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-6"
      register: s2_l2_state_output
      failed_when: s2_l2_state_output.rc != 0 or 'established' not in s2_l2_state_output.stdout | lower
      changed_when: false

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # H1 still cannot reach H2: L2 advertises nothing
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    - name: Verify L2 (SONiC-VS-2) advertises no routes to S2 (10.2.2.1)
      raw: sudo vtysh -c "show ip bgp neighbors 10.2.2.1 advertised-routes"
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-2"
      register: l2_adv_output
      failed_when: >-
        l2_adv_output.rc != 0
        or (l2_adv_output.stdout_lines | select('match', '^\s*\*') | list | length) > 0
      changed_when: false

    - name: Verify L1 (SONiC-VS-1) has no route to Vlan110 subnet (10.110.2.0/24)
      raw: sudo vtysh -c "show ip route 10.110.2.0/24"
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-1"
      register: l1_no_vlan110_route_output
      failed_when: >-
        l1_no_vlan110_route_output.rc == 0
        and 'Routing entry for 10.110.2.0/24' in l1_no_vlan110_route_output.stdout
      changed_when: false

    - name: Verify ping from L1 Vlan100 (10.100.1.1) to L2 Vlan110 (10.110.2.1) FAILS
      raw: ping -I 10.100.1.1 -c 3 -W 2 10.110.2.1
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-1"
      register: l1_to_l2_ping_output
      failed_when: l1_to_l2_ping_output.rc == 0
      changed_when: false

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # Final summary output
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    - name: Display L1 advertised routes to S1
      debug:
        var: l1_adv_to_s1_output.stdout_lines
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-1"

    - name: Display S1 BGP entry for 10.100.1.0/24
      debug:
        var: s1_bgp_route_output.stdout_lines
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-5"

    - name: Display S2 BGP entry for 10.100.1.0/24
      debug:
        var: s2_bgp_route_output.stdout_lines
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-6"

    - name: Display L1 to L2 ping result (expected to fail)
      debug:
        var: l1_to_l2_ping_output.stdout_lines
      when: inventory_hostname == "SONiC-VS-1"
